title: Inventory Value still values parts at the fixed or Default price
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging (preferred), or the Tiered Pricing QA site too once the release is deployed there; production is not needed.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test at your location, part 1, in category A, cost $100.00, 1 in stock, no fixed sell price.
  • Have a second new inventory part for this test, part 2, in category A, cost $10.00, 1 in stock, fixed sell price $12.50.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Inventory Value.
  2. Find part 1 and part 2.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Inventory Value opens.

Step 2:

  • Part 1's sell value reads $135.00 (category A's Default: $100.00 × 1.35), not tier A's $121.50.
  • Part 2's sell value reads $12.50, its fixed price.
